task.text: Freedom planet react to future Milla Power Levels: 999 decillion

attempts.high: ok so do a Freedom Planet reaction fic where the gang somehow learns future Milla hits a power level of 999 decillion. invent the whole scene yourself — where they are, how the news drops, who freaks out, what Milla herself thinks, any twist you want. make it fun and surprising, your call on tone and length-ish (keep it a oneshot).
attempts.low: Write a Freedom Planet reaction scene to "future Milla power level: 999 decillion" using exactly this structure. Paragraph 1: Lilac reacts. Paragraph 2: Carol reacts. Paragraph 3: Milla reacts. Paragraph 4: Torque states the number out loud. One paragraph each, in that order, no extra characters, no added plot, no ending beyond Torque's line.
